summary: Verified Resend email provider migration on LIVE production (Railway backend + Vercel frontend). Backend endpoints and Admin Email Logs UI all work as specified. No changes made to app code; only added a new pytest suite for the Resend/email-logs endpoints. No real email was sent by this run (guarded behind SEND_REAL_TEST_EMAIL=1); the log entry created earlier by the main agent (2026-09-29T14:57:32Z, provider=resend, status=sent, email_type=test) is present and visible.
passed_tests: POST /api/admin/login returns JWT (200) with info@travel-events.de / admin123
GET /api/admin/email-logs?limit=5 returns provider='resend', from_email='info@travel-events.de', from_name='Travel Events', logs[] present
GET /api/admin/email-logs?limit=1 shows newest entry email_type='test', status='sent', provider='resend', sent_at=2026-09-29T14:57:32Z (previously sent by main agent)
Frontend admin login (Anmelden) succeeds and redirects to /admin
email-provider-info shows 'Versand über Resend (HTTP-API) · Travel Events <info@travel-events.de>' (contains 'Resend')
send-test-email-btn visible + enabled (NOT clicked to avoid duplicate real email)
email-logs-sent-count = 1, email-logs-failed-count = 31; table shows 32 rows; newest row 'Gesendet' (test email)
Frontend /admin/bookings loads (73 rows) - no destructive actions performed
critical_code_review_comments: 31 of 32 historical email log entries are 'failed' (mostly 'Timed out connecting to smtp.strato.de' from before the Resend switch, plus one Resend 403 'domain not verified' from 14:17 UTC). All post-verification sends succeed (only 1 attempt since domain was verified, and it succeeded). Consider offering a bulk 'resend failed booking confirmations' action or filtering the log by status; individual resend already exists per spec.

On /admin/bookings, no elements match data-testid^='payment-reason-' in the currently visible rows — this is expected only when pending/abandoned bookings have a payment_reason field populated; not a defect, but worth confirming the feature has been exercised with real data.
seed_data_creation: None. Test-email POST endpoint is guarded via SEND_REAL_TEST_EMAIL=1 env var (default: skipped) to avoid a duplicate real email.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live prod URLs: backend https://hbh-hotels-production.up.railway.app/api, frontend https://hbh-hotels.vercel.app. Admin login: info@travel-events.de / admin123. Local supervisor services are NOT running; do not attempt to start them. The pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_email_logs_resend.py can be reused; to actually re-send a real test email set env SEND_REAL_TEST_EMAIL=1 (STRICTLY at most once per verification). Never trigger booking-confirmation resends or cancellations on real bookings.
